{{Ophiuchus}}
Ophiuchus 20 is the 356th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 20th day of Ophiuchus, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 51, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 13宮20日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 356|Chapter 356]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152375}}.
